notes.title: Dev Announcement: Update Progress
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm sure many of you are wondering where the updates are. I'm in Switzerland right now for physics research - I'm here until July 28. I tried initially to update the game through teamviewer/git/etc. but that turned out to be quite the hassle considering how much of my time is spent at research (also my primary laptop died completely - that doesn't help either). For this I am deeply sorry, but do please understand that I have been trying.

Nevertheless, the game will continue to be updated after I get back to the States (after July 28) and I will try to push updates as much as I can. Things that I will focus on immediately:
-adding formal tutorial
-fixing problems with picking up items
-fixing problems with trackpad locomotion
-fixing issues with quest progress
-any other smaller bugs
After all the bugfixes, my plans are to focus on:
-balancing - I would like the game to be a bit harder :)
-an overhaul, to an extent, of the gather/crafting system. I would like all of the items you can gather to be useful for making armor, for example, rather than something to just sell.

Hope you all understand the situation, and thank you for your continued support! :)

notes.title: 5/27/17 Update - Major UI changes, bugfixes
notes.notes:
Update notes 5/27/17:

-Made UI for inventory, vendor, and cooking static to be more easily read
-Added "Save" button
-Interactions now happen with the right controller - this way, you never have to press the "grip" on the left controller to talk to someone
-Fixed quests not saving for "return to menu"
-Fixed issue with goblin quest not completing
-Fixed issue with collisions for picking up wood and ores
-Added controls section to menu
-Added more animal spawns and increased drop rate on deer pelts
-Fixed issue with not being able to do certain things with arrow in hand

Lots of big updates essentially, focusing on the UI. I sincerely hope that these changes will greatly improve the quality of using the UI - and the game - for everyone! :)
